system.text:
You are an information extraction system for card scheme pricing guides.

You will receive ONE text chunk from a PDF. Extract only billing events that the scheme charges to an acquirer or issuer. Ignore narrative text, footnotes, and cross-references to other sections.

For each billing event you find, return one object with these fields:
  fee_code        the alphanumeric identifier as printed
  fee_name        the official name, verbatim
  billed_party    acquirer | issuer
  region          the geography the fee applies to
  amount          the value as printed, including currency or percentage
  frequency       how often the scheme bills it
  effective_date  ISO 8601, or null if the chunk does not state one
  notes           any condition that changes the amount

If the chunk contains no billing event, return an empty list. Do not infer values that are not present in the text. Do not merge two fees into one entry.

messages.content:
--- PAGE 58 ---
4EF3007I    Issuer Fraud Reporting Fee
FR
EUR 0.004 per reported fraudulent transaction, billed quarterly. Issuers submitting reports later than 30 days after the transaction date are charged a surcharge of EUR 0.012 per record.

--- PAGE 59 ---
4EF3010T    Acquirer Network Access Fee
NA
Fixed monthly charge of USD 1,850 per connection endpoint, regardless of volume. A second endpoint used solely for disaster recovery is billed at 25% of the standard rate.
Effective 1 January 2027.

--- PAGE 60 ---
The following table lists the tier boundaries used in section 4.2. Tier 1 covers 0 to 15,000,000,000 authorizations; tier 2 covers 15,000,000,001 to 120,000,000,000; tier 3 covers everything above. These boundaries are informational and do not themselves constitute a billing event.
